short_description: Gold and Graves is a roguelike extraction game where you bribe enemies to recruit them as allies, escape the dungeon, and bring back cards, relics, and mercenaries to your village to accumulate resources. Strengthen your deck and forces with the resources you gather and challenge deeper dungeons.
steam_categories: Single-player; Custom Volume Controls; Mouse Only Option; Playable without Timed Input; Steam Cloud; Family Sharing
steam_languages: English*, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean*languages with full audio support
